# {{ site.name | default: site.title }} — Research, projects and workshops

{{ site.author.bio | default: site.description }}

I work in Oracle AI Foundations under the guidance of [Dan Roth](https://www.cis.upenn.edu/~danroth/) and [Sujith Ravi](https://blogs.oracle.com/authors/sujithravi/), advancing agentic and enterprise AI, multimodal models, and media understanding.

This export reproduces this site's public project narratives, publication records, workshops and patent records, including labeled summaries and version notes. It is a research guide, not a full copy of the CV, media archive or every website page. Research results describe papers and do not establish the author's individual contribution or product deployment. Preprint classification follows the recorded venue, not the paper-link domain. Workshop roles are author-reported. Unknown workshop dates are omitted.

Navigation: {{ '/llms.txt' | absolute_url }}
Structured publications: {{ '/publications.json' | absolute_url }}
Structured workshops: {{ '/workshops.json' | absolute_url }}

## Applied research and project narratives

The following project descriptions reproduce public website content. They describe the author's scope and research direction; linked product documentation does not establish sole ownership or product-wide authorship. Pilots and ongoing work retain their stated status.
{% assign project_index = site.pages | where: 'url', '/projects/' %}
{% assign project_stories = site.pages | where: 'project_story', true | sort: 'title' %}
{% assign public_projects = project_index | concat: project_stories %}
{% for project_page in public_projects %}
### {{ project_page.title }}
Page: {{ project_page.url | absolute_url }}
{% assign rendered_project_content = project_page.content | markdownify -%}
{% assign project_link_parts = rendered_project_content | split: 'href="' -%}
{% assign project_sources = '' | split: '' -%}
{% for project_link_part in project_link_parts -%}
  {% assign project_source = project_link_part | split: '"' | first | replace: '&amp;', '&' -%}
  {% assign project_source_https = project_source | slice: 0, 8 -%}
  {% assign project_source_http = project_source | slice: 0, 7 -%}
  {% if project_source_https == 'https://' or project_source_http == 'http://' -%}
    {% unless project_sources contains project_source -%}
      {% assign project_sources = project_sources | push: project_source -%}
    {% endunless -%}
  {% endif -%}
{% endfor -%}
{% if project_sources.size > 0 %}
Sources:
{% for project_source in project_sources %}
- {{ project_source }}
{% endfor %}
{% endif %}

{% endfor %}
